_comment: Reference for the harness profile's mcp.json (mcp.json is yours once created; this example is part of the template). codebase-memory is a local stdio server (the pinned binary goes into <profile>/vendor, see docs/harness.md in the template's repository; index cache in <profile>/cbm-cache); context7 is a public remote server that needs no key. Put server tokens in environment variables, not in this file.
